entities.summary: Mehmed Kâmil Pasha, also spelled as Kâmil Pasha, was an Ottoman statesman and liberal politician of Turkish Cypriot origin in the late 19th century and early 20th century. He was the Grand Vizier of the Empire during four different periods.
